name: Necromancer: a mob killed by a commanded Ghoul is worth experience and loot (#4011, #4875)
contract: A Necromancer who orders a Ghoul at a mob has used an ability on that mob, so the mob belongs to that player. Creature::LowerPlayerDamageReq only records _damagedByPlayer from a player, from a unit a player moves, from a unit a player charms or from a player-controlled unit owned by a player (7f7131c76, #4221), and a Necromancer Guardian is none of those, so a Ghoul-only kill leaves Creature::IsDamageEnoughForLootingAndReward false and Unit::Kill clears the loot recipient. Casting Command: Undead 504868 on a mob must therefore hand that mob to the caster: the Ghoul kills it alone, the caster's experience rises and the caster may loot it.

steps.label: Let the Ghoul take its formation place
CONTROL: the Necromancer never swung at the kobold
SETUP: the Ghoul kills the kobold
A minion-only kill of a mob the player commanded is worth experience
The experience did not cross a level, so the delta is meaningful
The same kill is lootable by the player who commanded it
